features: Hand Carved Olive Wood Rosary Box 6.5 x 5.5 x 4 cm.
Made from premium Olive Wood in Bethlehem, the Holy Land.
Certificate of Origin included ( with Lord prayer card )
Beautiful artwork that will last for a lifetime. Other models are available as well, please contact us to check on availability.
Comes with a Certificate and Lord prayer Card as well.
description: This beautiful Olive Wood Box is hand-carved in Bethlehem, the Holy Land. The box is hinged with a gold-toned clasp or comes with a double magnets to close and open the box. Red velvet is lined on the inside. First Communion Chalice is engraved on the front of this box. This box can be used for putting a rosary or for keeping jewelry. The natural swirl and contrast of the olive wood grain will draw your mind. A great First Communion Gift Idea.
